title: Managed Database: capacity amendments
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database capacity amendments applies to database amend. The contract status is active or suspended. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes. The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start. Request and review events preserve those effective attributes. Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records. Refuse any change above maximum resource count or when completed monthly amendments has reached amendment limit. Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding. Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is active or suspended. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: amendment approved
The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, authorization request reference, source type. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, authorization request reference. 

## Account measurement
UTC calendar month containing the current handling time. Count completed request events of source type amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.
